user_decision.question: Both landed key-level step relations are now refuted by compilation: conStepStrong is not serial under certAdmK, and conStep's edges do not compose inside R already at length two. The pinned construction statement names the fibres of the GIVEN R, so GKWZ's own device -- elimination, restricting the set until the uniform relation becomes serial on what survives -- is not available. Which way should the plan be revised?
options: (A) Design a THIRD step relation on the key-level carrier, attack-first per this task's standing discipline: state a candidate (the largest subrelation of conStep whose edges compose, taken as a greatest fixpoint) and ATTEMPT TO REFUTE its seriality at ConAttack.attR before adopting it. Keeps the carrier, the pinned statement and the explicit-hypothesis form unchanged.

(B) Re-open the CARRIER instead of the relation: the determinism no-go (cellAt_subsingleton_of_det) forbids only a carrier whose world state determines a member under a type-reading truth lemma; a carrier that determines the key plus a bounded extra coordinate is not addressed by it. Attack-first on whether any such carrier satisfies the pinned equation.

(C) Re-open the pinned CONSTRUCTION statement: weaken its conclusion from the GIVEN R's fibres to the fibres of some certified subset of R, which is exactly what elimination delivers and what the published construction actually proves. This is a Statement Fidelity change and needs an explicit ruling.

(D) Park the construction half at this verdict and return to the READ-OFF half (Phase 20 / Phase 12.2), choosing its right-hand side with the construction's compiled obstructions in hand rather than its output.
user_decision.recommendation: (C) then (A). The round's own evidence points at the statement rather than at the relation: the obstruction is a two-member fibre of the GIVEN R whose members' successor keys part company, and no choice of step relation on a fixed R removes it -- both halves of the tension are instances of the same fact. Report 31 records that every converse direction in the published literature CONSTRUCTS its model from a set obtained BY ELIMINATION, which is precisely the subset-forming move option (C) would license. (C) is a Statement Fidelity ruling and is therefore the user's call, not the agent's; if it is declined, (A) is the next honest attempt and is attack-first.
